name: Historic Centre of Cordoba
description: In southern Spain's Andalusia, Córdoba's old town is one of Europe's largest historic centres, a maze of lanes layered with Roman, Islamic and Christian monuments. After the 8th-century Moorish conquest the city boasted some 300 mosques and rivalled Baghdad and Damascus. Its star sight is the Great Mosque, which became a cathedral in the 13th century, alongside the Christian-built Alcázar and the Calahorra tower.
